import sys
import random

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 12)
q = rng.randint(1, 20)
ops = []
for _ in range(q):
    t = rng.choice((1, 2))
    ops.append((t, rng.randint(1, n), rng.randint(1, n)))
if all(t == 1 for t, _, _ in ops):
    k = rng.randrange(q)
    ops[k] = (2, ops[k][1], ops[k][2])
print(n, q)
for t, a, b in ops:
    print(t, a, b)
